<script>
function toggleFaq(btn) {
  const body = btn.nextElementSibling;
  const icon = btn.querySelector('.faq-icon');
  const isOpen = body.style.display === 'block';
  // Close all
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-body').forEach(b => b.style.display = 'none');
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-icon').forEach(i => { i.textContent = '＋'; i.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)'; });
  // Open this one if it was closed
  if (!isOpen) {
    body.style.display = 'block';
    icon.textContent = '－';
    icon.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
  }
}
</script>

  if (PAGES.indexOf(id) === -1) id = 'home';
  for (var i = 0; i < PAGES.length; i++) {
    var pg = document.getElementById('page-' + PAGES[i]);
    var tb = document.getElementById('tab-' + PAGES[i]);
    if (pg) pg.className = (PAGES[i] === id) ? 'page on' : 'page';
    if (tb) tb.className = (PAGES[i] === id) ? 'ntab on' : 'ntab';
  }
  var mob = document.getElementById('mobNav');
  if (mob) mob.className = 'mob-nav';
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  if (id === 'products') { buildCats(); buildProds(); }
  var titles = {home:'CR Enterprise | Medical & Surgical Products | CRENEU',about:'About Us | CR Enterprise',products:'Products | CR Enterprise',certificates:'Certifications | CR Enterprise',clients:'Our Clients | CR Enterprise',contact:'Contact | CR Enterprise',faqs:'FAQs | CR Enterprise'};
  document.title = titles[id] || 'CR Enterprise';
}

function toggleMob() {
  var m = document.getElementById('mobNav');
  m.className = m.className === 'mob-nav' ? 'mob-nav open' : 'mob-nav';
}

var cats = ['All'];
for (var i = 0; i < products.length; i++) {
  if (cats.indexOf(products[i].cat) === -1) cats.push(products[i].cat);
}
var activeCat = 'All';
var cart = [];

function buildCats() {
  var el = document.getElementById('catBar');
  if (!el) return;
  var html = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < cats.length; i++) {
    var cls = cats[i] === activeCat ? 'cbt on' : 'cbt';
    html += '<button class="' + cls + '" onclick="setCat(\'' + cats[i] + '\')">' + cats[i] + '</button>';
  }
  el.innerHTML = html;
}

function buildProds() {
  var el = document.getElementById('prodGrid');
  if (!el) return;
  var filtered = activeCat === 'All' ? products : products.filter(function(p) { return p.cat === activeCat; });
  var html = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < filtered.length; i++) {
    var p = filtered[i];
    var inCart = false;
    for (var j = 0; j < cart.length; j++) { if (cart[j].id === p.id) { inCart = true; break; } }
    html += '<div class="pcard">';
    html += '<div class="pimg">' + p.icon + '<span class="ptag">' + p.cat + '</span></div>';
    html += '<div class="pbody">';
    html += '<h3>' + p.name + '</h3>';
    html += '<p>' + p.desc + '</p>';
    html += '<div class="pprice">Price on Request</div>';
    html += '<button class="badd' + (inCart ? ' added' : '') + '" onclick="addCart(' + p.id + ')">' + (inCart ? '✅ Added' : '+ Add to Cart') + '</button>';
    html += '</div></div>';
  }
  el.innerHTML = html;
}

function setCat(c) { activeCat = c; buildCats(); buildProds(); }

// ===== CART =====
function addCart(id) {
  var p = null;
  for (var i = 0; i < products.length; i++) { if (products[i].id === id) { p = products[i]; break; } }
  if (!p) return;
  var found = false;
  for (var i = 0; i < cart.length; i++) { if (cart[i].id === id) { cart[i].qty++; found = true; break; } }
  if (!found) cart.push({id:p.id, name:p.name, cat:p.cat, icon:p.icon, qty:1});
  updateBadge();
  buildProds();
  buildCartItems();
  toast('Added: ' + p.name);
}

function updateBadge() {
  var tot = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < cart.length; i++) tot += cart[i].qty;
  var b = document.getElementById('cbadge');
  b.textContent = tot;
  b.className = tot > 0 ? 'cbadge on' : 'cbadge';
  var t = document.getElementById('cartTotTxt');
  if (t) t.textContent = tot + ' item' + (tot !== 1 ? 's' : '');
}

function buildCartItems() {
  var el = document.getElementById('cartItems');
  if (!el) return;
  if (cart.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-cart"><div>🛒</div><p>Cart is empty.<br>Add products to enquire.</p></div>';
    return;
  }
  var html = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < cart.length; i++) {
    var item = cart[i];
    html += '<div class="ci-row">';
    html += '<div class="ci-ico">' + item.icon + '</div>';
    html += '<div class="ci-info"><h4>' + item.name + '</h4><p>' + item.cat + '</p>';
    html += '<div class="ci-qty"><button class="qb" onclick="chQty(' + item.id + ',-1)">-</button>';
    html += '<span class="qn">' + item.qty + '</span>';
    html += '<button class="qb" onclick="chQty(' + item.id + ',1)">+</button></div></div>';
    html += '<button class="ci-rm" onclick="rmCart(' + item.id + ')">✕</button></div>';
  }
  el.innerHTML = html;
}

function chQty(id, d) {
  for (var i = 0; i < cart.length; i++) {
    if (cart[i].id === id) { cart[i].qty += d; if (cart[i].qty <= 0) { cart.splice(i, 1); } break; }
  }
  updateBadge(); buildCartItems(); buildProds();
}

function rmCart(id) {
  for (var i = 0; i < cart.length; i++) { if (cart[i].id === id) { cart.splice(i, 1); break; } }
  updateBadge(); buildCartItems(); buildProds();
}

function openCart() {
  document.getElementById('cartOv').className = 'cart-ov open';
  document.getElementById('cartSb').className = 'cart-sb open';
}
function closeCart() {
  document.getElementById('cartOv').className = 'cart-ov';
  document.getElementById('cartSb').className = 'cart-sb';
}

// ===== ENQUIRY =====
function openEnq() {
  closeCart();
  var prods = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < cart.length; i++) prods += cart[i].name + ' (Qty: ' + cart[i].qty + ')\n';
  document.getElementById('eq-prods').value = prods;
  document.getElementById('eqOv').className = 'eq-ov open';
}
function closeEnq() {
  document.getElementById('eqOv').className = 'eq-ov';
  document.getElementById('eqWrap').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('eqSucc').style.display = 'none';
}
function submitEnq() {
  var n = document.getElementById('eq-name').value.trim();
  var p = document.getElementById('eq-phone').value.trim();
  if (!n || !p) { toast('Please fill name and phone'); return; }
  document.getElementById('eqWrap').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('eqSucc').style.display = 'block';
  cart = []; updateBadge(); buildCartItems(); buildProds();
}

  msg += '\nPlease share pricing. Thank you.';
  window.open('https://wa.me/919871456056?text=' + encodeURIComponent(msg), '_blank');
}

// ===== FAQ =====
function toggleFaq(btn) {
  var item = btn.parentElement;
  var allItems = document.querySelectorAll('.fitem');
  for (var i = 0; i < allItems.length; i++) {
    if (allItems[i] !== item) allItems[i].className = 'fitem';
  }
  item.className = item.className === 'fitem open' ? 'fitem' : 'fitem open';
}

  var names = {en:'English',hi:'Hindi',ta:'Tamil',te:'Telugu',bn:'Bengali',mr:'Marathi',gu:'Gujarati',kn:'Kannada',ml:'Malayalam',pa:'Punjabi',ur:'Urdu'};
  if (l !== 'en') toast(names[l] + ' version coming soon!');
}

// ===== TOAST =====
function toast(msg) {
  var t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.className = 'toast show';
  setTimeout(function() { t.className = 'toast'; }, 3000);
}

// ===== INIT =====
showPage('home');
</script>
</body>
</html>
